pages.text: Mekanism is the primary T3–$(t4)T4$(end) tech mod. Ore processing, gas handling, advanced machines, and the road to $(item)MekaSuit$(/item).

$(bold)T3 access:$(/bold) Basic Mekanism machines (Enrichment Chamber, Purification Chamber, Crusher, Chemical Injection) unlock at T3. Osmium is the $(t3)T3$(end) base material.$(br2)$(bold)Ore processing:$(/bold) Full Mekanism processing chain yields up to 5 ingots per ore. Building this chain is a major $(t3)T3$(end) engineering project.

$(bold)T4 upgrade:$(/bold) $(item)MekaTool$(/item), Mekasuit, QIO Network, Fusion Reactor, and Antimatter production are $(t4)T4$(end) content. Planning your $(t3)T3$(end) infrastructure for $(t4)T4$(end) upgrades is a good use of $(t3)T3$(end) time.$(br2)$(bold)Artificer synergy:$(/bold) Efficient Engineering boosts all Mekanism factory speeds. $(t3)T3$(end) Artificer is the fastest path to T4.

$(bold)No book needed.$(/bold) Mekanism is documented via JEI and the $(bold)Mekanism wiki$(/bold) (mekanismmod.com). In-game, hover any machine in JEI and press $(bold)R$(/bold) for recipes, $(bold)U$(/bold) for uses.
